content:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: SEV2 - routing-errors spikes in eu-west1 affecting live inference. Trigger: 5xx rate > 8% for 5m on routing-tier=paid and fallback activations rising. Incident link: https://pd.redwood.example/INC12345

sara.ops: seeing the same in console, spike at 10:12 UTC. Noted customer error reports (prod). tagging oncall. @mike-sre are you available?

mike-sre: taking it. I'm oncall and joining. initial checks: control plane reachable, but routing decisions show increased fallback hits to quantized-variant-v2.

raj.prod: customer-facing triage: two enterprise customers reported degraded latencies and token-level errors, both routed to eu-west1. One reported model outputs truncated/garbled. Holding communications until we know root cause.

amelia-ml: quick hypothesis: fallback selection may be matching a model variant with incompatible KV cache layout for this architecture -> leading to invalid token stream. I saw similar symptoms in canary last quarter. Will pull eval logs.

noah-eng: capturing logs now. Piping recent router decisions for a sample window (10:05-10:15):
```
# sample lines from routing-decision.log
2026-03-10T10:07:12Z route_id=rt-72 region=eu-west1 tier=paid selected=quantized-variant-v2 fallback=true reason=overflow
2026-03-10T10:07:13Z route_id=rt-89 region=eu-west1 tier=free selected=base-compat-v1 fallback=false
2026-03-10T10:07:18Z route_id=rt-72 region=eu-west1 tier=paid selected=quantized-variant-v2 fallback=true error=kv-cache-mismatch
```

noah-eng: adding a couple of `kubectl logs` snippets from the runtime pod (in eu-west1) showing decoding errors:
```
E 10:07:18 runtime: kv cache mismatch: expected 64B pages, got 128B
E 10:07:19 runtime: stream-error: decoding failed, dropping request
```

mike-sre: good capture. Starting live mitigation: pin routing policy to prefer base-compat-v1 for paid tier in eu-west1, and disable automatic fallback to quantized-variant-v2. Applying policy change now.

inc-bot: Deploy request queued: change-id=chg-879, requested-by=mike-sre. Apply to policy-router-eu-west1.

mike-sre: applied. Observability: 5xx rate dropped from 8.9% to 1.3% within ~90s. Rolling back the fallback selection was effective as mitigation.

sara.ops: great. Notifying customers now that mitigation is in place. @raj.prod will follow up with incident summary and ETA for fix?

raj.prod: will send customer note in 15m once we confirm stability for 30m. Current impact: two enterprise customers experienced degraded responses (partial corrupt outputs) between 10:05-10:12 UTC, approx 7k requests total. No data exfiltration reported.

amelia-ml: digging into model onboarding logs: quantized-variant-v2 was recently introduced for eu-west1 pools with a different KV cache layout optimization. The compatibility tag in the model manifest was accidentally omitted (`compatible_kv_layout: false` missing). That allowed router to consider it compatible and fall back into it.

noah-eng: confirming manifests pulled at 09:50 had:
```
model: quantized-variant-v2
metadata:
  quant: int8
  compatible_hardware: [A100, H100]
  # missing: compatible_kv_layout
```

amelia-ml: that aligns. Hypothesis 1: missing manifest flag allowed fallback to an incompatible variant -> runtime decoding errors -> 5xx. Hypothesis 2: routing tier overflow logic favours quantized variants aggressively under load, which triggered fallback quickly.

mike-sre: adding to timeline (in-thread):
- 09:50 manifest sync pulled quantized-variant-v2 into eu-west1 pool
- 10:05 increased load causes router to hit capacity on base variant for some shards
- 10:07 router triggers fallback rule -> picks quantized-variant-v2 because tag missing
- 10:07-10:12 runtime logs show kv-cache mismatch + decoding errors -> 5xx spike
- 10:13 mitigation: policy pinned to base-compat-v1 -> 5xx rates returned to baseline by 10:15

sara.ops: actions to fix (short term): block quantized-variant-v2 fallback in eu-west1 until manifest corrected and a canary run. Long term: add manifest validation at model registry ingestion.

amelia-ml: agreed. I'll open a model-registry ticket and add a preflight validation that enforces `compatible_kv_layout` presence and sanity checks. Also schedule a small canary rollout with decoding smoke tests.

noah-eng: ops action items:
- roll forward a manifest patch to include `compatible_kv_layout: true|false` for quantized-variant-v2 and re-tag as incompatible for eu-west1 if needed (assigned to @noah-eng)
- add guardrail in router to ignore variants lacking `compatible_kv_layout` when evaluating fallback choices (assigned to @mike-sre)
- create alert for sudden increase in fallback->runtime-errors correlation (assigned to @sara.ops)

mike-sre: assigned. Working on router guardrail patch now. ETA for PR + canary: ~3h.

raj.prod: customer comms draft queued. Will push once we hit 30m stable window.

inc-bot: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by mike-sre. Severity downgraded to SEV3 at 10:40 UTC after mitigation and continued monitoring.

sara.ops: final note: RCA hypothesis matches evidence. We'll open a post-incident RFC for model manifest validation and router fallback policy tightening. Thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:
